question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The __cacophony __in the theatre was too much for us.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"cacophony"** means a harsh, discordant mixture of sounds. (कर्णकटु ध्वनि)

 
 
• **Example: **The **cacophony **of honking horns and shouting vendors filled the air.
 
 
 
• **"Noise" **refers to any sound, especially one that is loud or unpleasant or that causes disturbance. (शोर)
 
 
• **Example: **The** noise** from the construction site made it hard to concentrate.
 
 

Therefore, the correct synonym of **cacophony** is **noise.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Silence **(चुप्पी): The absence of any sound or noise.

 
 
• **Example:** The **silence **in the library was broken only by the turning of pages.
 
 
 
• **Smell **(गंध): The sense by which odors are perceived.
 
 
• **Example: **The **smell** of fresh bread filled the room.
 
 
 
• **Laughter** (हंसी): The action or sound of laughing.
 
 
• **Example:** The room was filled with** laughter **during the comedy show.
